An UPDATE 🚨 on #HMPV. 
Symptoms : include cough, fever, shortness of breath. 
Spreads through respiratory route/contact through infected person. 
Diagnosed by RTPCR on nasal/throat swabs. 
Treatment is symptomatic only.
